text: Hours of stream. One moment you remember. No idea when it happened. Sem VOD is Control F for your stream. Find the moment, and turn it into something worth sharing.

This is a real Twitch integration test on ottobottr. We broadcast our own illustrated sample artwork through O B S. Sem VOD captured the program scene every two seconds and connected to Twitch chat through Event Sub. No private desktop, webcam, or microphone was used.

After the stream, type what you remember. Here, I search for dog. The heatmap shows visual relevance across the recording. Select a peak to inspect the frame, or choose one of the strongest separated matches. A different memory, like brightest blue, reveals a different part of the stream. The streamer stays in control of what matters.

Chat energy provides another signal. In a separate capture test, this real message arrived from Twitch while O B S frames were being recorded. Phrase search uses recorded chat text. Sem VOD does not claim to transcribe the audio.

Once you find a moment, download a twelve eighty by seven twenty cover, with an optional title. Sem VOD also finds the matching Twitch archive and creates a clip around the selected timestamp. This thirty second clip was created by the app's VOD clip endpoint and confirmed on Twitch. A timestamp link is available when Twitch blocks clipping.

The cost controls are built in. Our sixty three captured frames collapse to eight unique images in one short contact sheet. Only the strongest candidates get a refinement pass. Scores are saved by normalized query, image content, model, and prompt version. Repeat the search, even after restarting, and the app reuses its scores with zero paid vision calls.

I built Sem VOD with Codex in one thread. Codex checked the official API contracts, wrote the recorder, chat connection, search, interface, and tests. My feedback pushed for memoization, smaller images, and fewer dependencies. Twenty two tests pass, alongside the real Twitch and isolated O B S checks. The source, original sample, and setup instructions are in the repository.
Sem VOD runs locally using the streamer's own OpenAI key. Next: a replay queue for moderators, automatic chapters, and vertical covers. Sem VOD. Control F for your stream.
